svg.title: Kumo merges a password-protected PDF with another PDF
svg.desc: Two PDFs are dropped on Kumo: notes.pdf, which has a password, and slides.pdf. Kumo asks for the password of notes.pdf and uses it to open the file; it does not remove or get around the protection. Both are merged on this PC into a new file, notes (merged).pdf, saved without a password. The two original files stay unchanged, and notes.pdf keeps its password.
svg.text: Merge PDFs, one with a password
